Project Overview

Building an Identity for Educational Excellence

Maadi Brighton International School (MBIS) is an international education brand developed around the values of trust, academic excellence, personal growth, and inspiration.

The identity combines traditional academic symbolism with a refined contemporary aesthetic, creating a visual language that reflects educational credibility and future-focused thinking.

Institution International School
Project Type Client Project
Creative Direction Academic & Contemporary
Project Status Client Approved

02 / 10

The Challenge

The identity needed to communicate academic excellence, build confidence, and establish a distinctive institutional presence. It had to balance educational tradition with a modern, inspiring direction for parents, students, and the wider educational community.

Parents & Families

Seeking a trustworthy educational environment that supports achievement and personal development.

Students

Looking for an inspiring environment that encourages curiosity, confidence, and ambition.

Educational Community

Teachers and stakeholders who value professionalism and academic standards.

Visual Identity System

A Cohesive Visual Language

الألوان

The palette combines the institutional character of navy blue with the distinction and warmth of gold, supported by neutral and complementary tones.

الخطوط والعناصر الجرافيكية

Cairo Bold and Regular provide clear Arabic communication, while Playfair Display brings an academic character to English headlines and Inter ensures readable supporting text. The supporting graphic language includes shield patterns, growth lines, stars, and educational icons.

Social Media Identity

Content Direction

10 / 10

Final Brand Experience

One Identity. A Consistent Educational Presence.

The final MBIS identity brings together the logo system, visual language, and selected application concepts into a unified brand direction.

The system establishes a coherent visual foundation that reflects the school's ambition, academic character, and commitment to student development. The final visual identity was approved by the client.
